slides.texte_overlay:
How to be the man your
family can count on

1. Be on time

For dinner, for pickups,
for the hard talks.

2. Fix things yourself

The shelf, the tire,
the dripping tap.

3. Know a little
about everything

Homework questions, news,
how things work.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. Know a little
about everything

I learn a bit every day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. Have a plan for
emergencies

Numbers saved, a kit ready.
Calm when it counts.

5. Call your parents
every week

Not only when you need something.

6. Do what you said

Small promises build
big trust at home.
